# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives fixes. Please update before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Common-Fool/Video-Streams-Preview-Organizer/security/advisories/new)
(Security → Report a vulnerability).

Include the VSPO version, your OS, what you did, what happened and, if you can,
the steps to reproduce it.

VSPO runs a local web server for its window, launches ffmpeg and your video
player, and moves and deletes files in the folders you open, so reports about
any of these are especially welcome.
